title: Window functions
summary: Rank, aggregate, and offset over partitions with OVER, ROW_NUMBER, LAG/LEAD, and frames.

items: Use ranking, aggregate, and offset window functions.
Pick RANK vs DENSE_RANK vs ROW_NUMBER.

blocks.body: Window functions compute across a set of rows related to the current row without collapsing them.

terms.definition: Defines the window (PARTITION BY / ORDER BY / frame) for a window function.
The subset of rows in the partition used for the calculation (ROWS/RANGE BETWEEN).

blocks.body: `ROW_NUMBER`, `RANK`, `DENSE_RANK`, `NTILE` for ranking; `SUM/AVG/... OVER (...)` for running totals; `LAG`/`LEAD` for offsets; `FIRST_VALUE`/`LAST_VALUE` with explicit frames. `ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` gives a running total.

items.mistake: Expecting LAST_VALUE to return the partition's last row by default.
items.fix: Set the frame to ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.

tips: ROW_NUMBER is always unique; RANK leaves gaps; DENSE_RANK doesn't.

blocks.body: Master OVER with PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, and explicit frames — window functions appear throughout the exam.
